title: IEC 61800-5-1:2022 — Safety requirements: electrical, thermal and energy
version: IEC 61800-5-1:2022, Edition 3.0; Corrigenda 1 (2023-09) and 2 (2025-12) incorporated in current copy
locator: IEC official catalogue scope: adjustable-speed PDS and elements; electrical, thermal, fire, mechanical, energy and other relevant hazards; driven equipment excluded except interface requirements.
notes: 标准全文未下载/归档。PDS安全标准不替代机床整机风险评估、机械防护和安全功能验证；具体适用性须结合系统边界和国家/地区法规。
